ProtocolProbe.StartTlsBlockReason: Known upstream .NET bug on Linux — StartTransportLayerSecurity fails on both .NET 8 (PS 7.4.6) and .NET 10 (PS 7.6.5) even with cert validation disabled (TLS_REQCERT never). Same OpenLDAP library works via ldapsearch -ZZ. Same code works on Windows runner. LDAPS (port 636) works on both .NET versions on Linux. Tracked: dotnet/runtime#96988, #110391. Not a Maester code defect.

WindowsRunner.OriginalBlockReason: Azure VM Run Command extension permanently stuck (Conflict: Run command extension execution is in progress). Recovery attempts failed.
WindowsRunner.RecoveryMethod: OpenSSH Server installed via last successful Run Command; SSH password auth validated for local admin and domain user; PowerShell set as default SSH shell; DC certs installed via scp/Import-Certificate

ProtocolProbe.ImplicitBlockReason: Resolved. Added fallback to Get-MtAmbientDomainController that queries [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain().PdcRoleOwner.Name when $env:LOGONSERVER and $env:USERDNSDOMAIN are empty. All implicit-credential rows now pass via GSSAPI (Kerberos) SSH. Password-based SSH still fails because it does not provide a domain identity.
ProtocolProbe.Dc04BlockReason: Resolved. DC04 explicit-basic-ldaps now passes after three fixes: (1) installing DC04 LDAPS cert into LocalMachine\Root, (2) adding conditional DNS forwarder for misoule03.local on DC02, (3) fixing PowerShell password escaping in test scripts.

PublicE2E.Notes: All 11 rows pass (1,2,3,4,5,6,7 PASS; N1,N3,N4,N5 meet expectations). Implicit rows 1,2 now pass via GSSAPI SSH after the Get-MtAmbientDomainController fallback was added.
